answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a lantern for identifying unique human nodes within a decentralized network. By requiring cryptographic attestation of biometric uniqueness, the system renders a tundra of Sybil accounts impossible to cultivate. Any zephyr of adversarial activity is neutralized because an attacker must pay the high cost of acquiring distinct physical identities, which is economically prohibitive compared to the marginal gains of malicious node replication.
